name: SA water and sewerage rate concession
summary: Discount of up to 30% of your yearly water bill for low-income South Australians, including tenants who pay for water.
key: The water concession is calculated as up to 30% of your total water bill for a financial year.
who: Own or rent your principal place of residence and pay for water
Hold an eligible card such as a Low Income Health Care Card, receive an eligible payment such as Youth Allowance or Austudy, or meet low income provisions
how: Apply with the online household concessions form or call ConcessionsSA on 1800 307 758.
catches: Tenants are not eligible for a concession on sewerage rates.
2026-27 water concession for tenants paying usage only is $197.20 to $377.90.
